statement: You receive a sorted row of integers in ascending order and a target integer. Decide whether the target appears in the row using binary search: test the middle value, rule out the half that can no longer contain the target, and repeat on the remaining window. Print 1 if the target is present and 0 if it is absent.
constraints: The row is sorted ascending and may contain duplicates.

example.why: Mid value 5 is too small, so the left half is ruled out; the next window finds 7.

hint: After every comparison exactly one half plus the middle itself must leave the window.
mistake: Moving a border to mid instead of past it - the window stops shrinking and the loop never ends.
